text:
Nora J: quick flagging: some requests include both X-Client-Hint: v2 and a sticky token tied to legacy routing; result is noisy telemetry and a few tenants landing on old pools.
Sam K: ugh. Do we treat token affinity as higher priority today?
Diego M: yes. Current flow: token_affinity -> client_hint -> shard_hash. Token wins when present.
Lina F: customers reasonably expect explicit client hints to take precedence. We should avoid surprising them.
Nora J: short-term idea: a non-invasive simulation mode that computes what would have happened if hints took precedence (no change to routing).
Sam K: love simulation. Metric names we can use: `routing.signal_override.total` and `routing.simulator.header_wins`.
Diego M: implementation: add a lightweight simulator hook in the router that, when sampled, emits `simulator.would_route_to=v2` and a small breadcrumb to logs. Keep payload <150 bytes.
Lina F: sampling strategy: global 0.25% by default, 2% for tenants marked `experiment:hint_sim`. Add console control to mark tenants.
Nora J: also need a pool-shift risk estimate: how many active sessions move from dedicated->shared and estimated token-cost delta. Call it `quota.shift_risk` and show on tenant page.
Sam K: projection can reuse last 14 days of routing histograms to compute likely shifts. We'll show a 7-day projection and an uncertainty band.
Diego M: safety: if a tenant later flips to actual hint-precedence and their error-rate spikes (>2x baseline for 5m) auto-sticky them back to token_affinity for 20m and page oncall.
Lina F: UX: in Console add a small toggle labeled "Prefer client hint (experimental)" with states: Off / Simulate / Enforce. Provide an "Estimate impact" action.
Nora J: add a clear note: "Simulate shows projected pool movement — does not change routing". Also add a lightweight KQL snippet for ops: `logs | where simulator_would == "v2" | summarize count() by tenant`.
Sam K: add tracing tag `routing.simulator_decision` and a metric `routing.simulator.sample_rate`. NB: do not enable simulator for more than 1% globally.
Diego M: also add an event `console.action.estimate_run` so we can attribute estimates to whoever ran them (support/SE).
Lina F: docs: recommend SDKs send only one version signal. Add a quick bullet list: prefer header, fall back to token, pin tokens via Console if needing stickiness.
ops-bot: Created ticket ENG-4999: "version-signal simulator + tenant risk projection" assigned to @Diego M and @Lina F. ETA: 4 working days for simulator MVP.
Nora J: small prod concern: if we later flip precedence globally, we'll need a preflight job that runs the projection across all tenants and flags high-risk ones. Let's add `routing.preflight.batch_run` to backlog.
Sam K: agree. Also add dashboard alerts for `quota.shift_risk > threshold` so sales/support can proactively reach out.
Diego M: I'll sketch the router change with a tri-state enum: HINT_MODE = {OFF, SIMULATE, ENFORCE} and wire to per-tenant config.
Lina F: thanks folks. I'll mock Console copy and mockups and drop them here tomorrow.
Nora J: thanks all. leaving thread open for updates.
